# Phase 30 baseline — gh-absent fallback behavior
# Source: scripts/lib/issue-reporter/gh-absent-fallback.cjs (Plan 30-06, D-10)
# When `gh` CLI is not installed, drop the payload to disk + copy the
# issue-template URL to clipboard via platform-specific commands.

# Platform-specific clipboard command:
linux:   xclip -selection clipboard
macos:   pbcopy
windows: clip

# Draft-on-disk path:
draft-on-disk-path: <repo-root>/.design/issue-drafts/<ISO-timestamp>-<slug>.md

# Clipboard content (issue-template URL, hardcoded in destination.cjs):
clipboard-url: https://github.com/hegemonart/hone/issues/new?template=bug_report.md

# User-facing output:
# - prints the draft path
# - prints "URL copied to clipboard"
# - prints "Open <clipboard-url> in your browser to file the issue"
